# DRX Cleaning Company

> DRX Cleaning Company provides professional carpet cleaning, upholstery cleaning, sofa cleaning, mattress sanitization, stain removal, odor removal, residential cleaning, and commercial carpet cleaning services in Orlando and Central Florida.

Website: https://www.drxcleaning.com/

Primary Location: Orlando, Florida, United States

## Business Summary

DRX Cleaning Company is a local cleaning service specializing in professional carpet cleaning and fabric care for homes, apartments, offices, rental properties, commercial spaces, and property managers. Services include hot-water extraction carpet cleaning, upholstery and sofa cleaning, mattress sanitization, pet stain and odor removal, deep cleaning, and commercial carpet cleaning.

The company emphasizes eco-friendly cleaning products, licensed and insured service, same-day or next-day availability when scheduling allows, and a satisfaction-focused service experience.
